text: When reading news about Bitcoin or stocks,
trading ideas often emerge before you even open an exchange.
Yet, checking the market usually requires switching tabs,
searching for an asset, and calculating risk.
This breaks your train of thought, making it easy for a calculated decision
to turn into an impulsive one.
Strike everywhere, bring strikes market data directly to the page you are currently reading.
Once a ticker is detected, a single click reveals the price, funding rates,
and a risk simulation based on 30 days of historical data.
Jeff helps interpret the perspective and assesses whether the claim is clear enough to be put to the test.
From there, you can create a ghost trade, a virtual position that requires no wallet and no actual capital.
Then, open the receipt to review the original claim, associated costs, and the results of the simulation.
Because understanding the market should begin the moment and idea strikes.
For traders, the benefit is straightforward.
Minimize tab switching, test your assumptions, and evaluate your decisions before putting any capital at risk.
